Software X User Manual

Welcome to the official user manual for Software X, the secure and scalable solution for handling sensitive data with ease. This guide will walk you through installation, configuration, daily usage, and troubleshooting.

Table of Contents ​

  • 1. Installation
  • 2. Configuration
  • 3. Core Features
  • 4. Advanced Usage
  • 5. Troubleshooting

  • 1. Installation ​

    Software X is distributed as a platform‑agnostic bundle (Linux/Windows/macOS). Follow the steps below to get the application up and running.

    1.1. Pre‑install Checks ​

    • Operating system: Ubuntu ≥ 20.04, Windows 10 ≥ 1903, macOS ≥ 10.15.
    • Java 17 (Oracle OpenJDK) installed and available in PATH.
    • OpenSSL 1.1.1+ for TLS support.

    1.2. Quick Start ​

    1. Download the ZIP archive from https://downloads.softwarex.com/latest.
    2. Extract the archive to your desired directory, e.g., C:\Program Files\SoftwareX or /opt/softwarex.
    3. Run softwarex.sh (Linux/macOS) or softwarex.bat (Windows).

    For a more detailed installation guide, see the Installation Guide PDF.

      Note: If you encounter a "Ports in use" error, stop any background services occupying 8080 or 8443.

    2. Configuration ​

    After installation, configure the application to match your environment. The primary configuration file is config.yaml.

    2.1. Basic Configuration ​

    server:
  port: 8443
  tls:
    certfile: /etc/softwarex/cert.pem
    keyfile: /etc/softwarex/key.pem
database:
  type: postgres
  url: jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/softwarex
  user: swx_user
  password: *****

    2.2. Advanced Settings ​

    Optional features that can be enabled:

    • Audit> – Enable to write activity logs to /var/log/softwarex/audit.log.
    • Event Streaming – Kafka/Redis support for real‑time event consumption.
    • Multi‑Tenant Mode – Reserved for enterprise deployments.
     

    3. Core Features ​

    3.1. Secure Data Upload ​

    Upload files or JSON payloads via the web interface or REST API. Data is encrypted on‑disk at rest using AES‑256.

    curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -F "file=@'/path/to/document.pdf'" \
  https://localhost:8443/api/v1/upload

    All uploads are validated against user roles and policy rules.

    ​

    3.2. Data Search & Retrieval ​

    Search across all uploaded content using keyword or advanced filters.

    • Keyword search (full‑text).
    • Attribute filters (date range, file type).
    • Role‑based access control.

    Example query using the REST API:

    curl -X GET \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  "https://localhost:8443/api/v1/search?query=confidential&start=2023-01-01"
    ​

    3.3. Data Export ​

    Export search results as CSV, PDF, or JSON. Use the "Export" button in the UI or the following API endpoint:

    curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -F "searchId=abc123" \
  https://localhost:8443/api/v1/export

    Files can be stored locally or pushed to an external S3 bucket.

    ​

    4. Advanced Usage ​

    4.1. Automation & Scripting ​

    Integrate with your CI/CD pipelines or scheduled jobs. A sample bash script is provided below.

    # Automate daily backup
export SWX_TOKEN=$(cat /etc/softwarex/token.txt)
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SWX_TOKEN" \
  -F "file=@'/backups/today.zip'" \
  https://prod.softwarex.com/api/v1/upload

    Schedule the script with cron or Windows Task Scheduler.

    ​

    4.2. Data Retention Policies ​

    Set automatic deletion rules to comply with regulatory requirements.

    policy.json:
{
  "name": "Delete intermediate staging",
  "criteria": {
    "fileAgeDays": 90,
    "folder": "/staging"
  },
  "action": "delete"
}

    Upload the policy file via POST /api/v1/policies.

    ​

    5. Troubleshooting ​

    5.1. Common Issues ​

    • Connection refused – Verify the server is running and the port is open.
    • Certificate validation failed – Ensure the CA chain in cert.pem is correct.
    • Authentication error – Refresh the token or check user permissions.
    ​

    5.2. Logging and Metrics ​

    Logs are written to /var/log/softwarex/application.log and can be rotated using logrotate.

    Metrics are exposed via Prometheus endpoint at /metrics.

    ​

    5.3. Contact Support ​

    If you cannot resolve an issue, open a ticket at support.softwarex.com. Include the following:

    • Application version (e.g., v1.4.0)
    • Error logs (last 100 lines)
    • Reproduction steps

    6. Glossary ​

    TermDefinition
    Encryption Protecting data by converting it into unreadable forms.
    Zero‑Knowledge Proof Cryptographic method where a prover proves knowledge of a secret to a verifier without revealing it.
    API Key Token used in place of username/password to authenticate a client.
    Regulatory Compliance Adherence to industry laws and standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).
